messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: Datadog ingestion lag detected for org=redwood-prod. Logs and metrics arriving delayed or not searchable since 11:07 UTC. Rule: dd.ingest.delay.high. Thread created 1972456789
Nina (oncall): Taking this. Pager duty and support on it. First step: confirm if alerts suppressed by DD.
PagerDuty-bot: PD incident PD-INC-9123 created and paged to oncall.
Ethan R: Confirmed DD UI shows last log at ~11:07. Prometheus scrapes are fine; host health okay. Looks like intake/backpressure on DD side.
Lina S: CS flagged customer dashboards stale. I'm drafting a customer-facing blurb. Also checking CloudWatch for raw logs.
Nina (oncall): While DD investigates, enable our emergency monitoring bridge to Slack and start log fallback: 
```
./ops/bridge.sh --from prometheus --to #alerts --since 11:00
kubectl -n infra exec deploy/fluentd -- /bin/sh -c "fluentdctl route --target s3-fallback"
```
Ethan R: Noted a recent rollout to log-collector at 11:03. Rolling that back as a precaution: 
```
kubectl -n infra rollout undo daemonset/log-collector --to-revision=5
```
incident-bot: Note: repeated DD alerts suppressed to reduce noise.
Datadog-support: Hi Redwood team, we're aware of partial ingestion delays in US and EU regions. Investigating an upstream proxy config change. ETA normalization 15-30m. Please upload agent diagnostics if requested.
Lina S: Uploaded a small sample of missing logs to S3 for DD and for our analysis: https://s3.console.aws.amazon.com/s3/object/redwood-ops/dd-fallback/1972456789-sample.log
Ethan R: Temporarily lowering tracing sampling to reduce pressure: 
```
curl -X POST https://config.internal/flags -d '{"trace.sampling":0.25}'
```
Nina (oncall): Status page note drafted: "Investigating delays in Datadog ingestion affecting dashboards and alerts. Alternate monitoring enabled; engineers are mitigating. Next update in 20 minutes." Lina pls post after review. :+1:
Lina S: Posted. CS has been notified to expect stale dashboards between 11:07-11:35 UTC.
Datadog-support: Update: backlog is being backfilled; ingestion normalizing in most regions. We'll keep the ticket open for 24h. Recommend verifying whether any alerts triggered during the delay need to be re-evaluated.
Ethan R: I'm seeing logs reappear with ingestion timestamps ~10-14m shifted. Backfill visible in our DD account.
Nina (oncall): Ok. Re-enable normal routing and keep the Prometheus->Slack bridge for an hour. Please capture timeline for postmortem. Action items: 1) add runbook step to enable local alert bridge, 2) add canary checks on log-collector rollouts.
Lina S: Final internal note: customer impact window 11:07-11:35 UTC. CS to reach out to customers with affected dashboards.
incident-bot: Automated note: live mitigation closed at 1972457010. Postmortem required.
Nina (oncall): Thanks team. I'll create the postmortem doc with timeline, root cause (Datadog upstream proxy config rotation), mitigations, and follow-ups. Will assign owners. :heart:
